<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #070912;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: min(96vw, calc(96vh * 4 / 3));
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(90, 120, 255, 0.25);
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" aria-label="Brick breaker game"></canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

// ---------- Setup ----------
const W = 800, H = 600, HUD_H = 50;
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
canvas.width = W * dpr;
canvas.height = H * dpr;
ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

const FONT = '"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif';

// ---------- Config ----------
const BRICK_TYPES = {
  a: { color: '#ff5d73', hits: 1, points: 50 },
  b: { color: '#ff9f43', hits: 1, points: 40 },
  c: { color: '#feca57', hits: 1, points: 30 },
  d: { color: '#1dd1a1', hits: 1, points: 20 },
  e: { color: '#54a0ff', hits: 1, points: 10 },
  H: { color: '#c8d6e5', damaged: '#8395a7', hits: 2, points: 100 },
};

// '.' = empty, letters = brick types above. 'H' bricks take two hits.
const LEVELS = [
  {
    ballSpeed: 380,
    paddleWidth: 120,
    layout: [
      'aaaaaaaaaa',
      'bbbbbbbbbb',
      'cccccccccc',
      'dddddddddd',
      'eeeeeeeeee',
    ],
  },
  {
    ballSpeed: 450,
    paddleWidth: 100,
    layout: [
      '....HH....',
      '...HaaH...',
      '..HabbaH..',
      '.HabccbaH.',
      'HabcddcbaH',
      '.HabccbaH.',
      '..HabbaH..',
      '...HaaH...',
      '....HH....',
    ],
  },
];

const COLS = 10, GAP = 6, SIDE = 30, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 30;
const BRICK_W = (W - SIDE * 2 - GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
const PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 50, PADDLE_SPEED = 650;
const BALL_R = 8, MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3, START_LIVES = 3;

// ---------- State ----------
// mode: title | serve | playing | paused | levelclear | gameover | win
const state = {
  mode: 'title',
  prevMode: 'serve',
  score: 0,
  lives: START_LIVES,
  level: 0,
  speed: 0,
  bricks: [],
  particles: [],
  flash: { text: '', time: 0 },
};
const paddle = { x: 0, w: LEVELS[0].paddleWidth };
const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
const keys = { left: false, right: false };

const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));

// ---------- Sound ----------
let audio = null, muted = false;

function ensureAudio() {
  try {
    if (!audio) {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AC) audio = new AC();
    }
    if (audio && audio.state === 'suspended') audio.resume();
  } catch (e) { audio = null; }
}

function beep(freq, dur, type = 'square', vol = 0.05, delay = 0) {
  if (muted || !audio) return;
  const t0 = audio.currentTime + delay;
  const osc = audio.createOscillator();
  const gain = audio.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audio.destination);
  osc.start(t0);
  osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

function jingle(notes) {
  notes.forEach((f, i) => beep(f, 0.18, 'triangle', 0.08, i * 0.12));
}

// ---------- Game flow ----------
function loadLevel(i) {
  const lvl = LEVELS[i];
  state.level = i;
  state.bricks = [];
  state.particles = [];
  lvl.layout.forEach((row, r) => {
    [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const type = BRICK_TYPES[ch];
      if (!type) return;
      state.bricks.push({
        x: SIDE + c * (BRICK_W + GAP),
        y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + GAP),
        w: BRICK_W,
        h: BRICK_H,
        type,
        hits: type.hits,
        alive: true,
      });
    });
  });
  paddle.w = lvl.paddleWidth;
  paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  state.speed = LEVELS[state.level].ballSpeed;
  ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
  stickBall();
}

function stickBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1;
}

function newGame() {
  state.score = 0;
  state.lives = START_LIVES;
  loadLevel(0);
  state.mode = 'serve';
  flash('LEVEL 1');
}

function launch() {
  const angle = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (Math.PI / 9); // up to ±20° from vertical
  ball.vx = state.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -state.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  state.mode = 'playing';
  beep(520, 0.08);
}

function flash(text) {
  state.flash.text = text;
  state.flash.time = 1.6;
}

// Primary action: mouse click, Space or Enter.
function action() {
  ensureAudio();
  switch (state.mode) {
    case 'title':
    case 'gameover':
    case 'win':
      newGame();
      break;
    case 'serve':
      launch();
      break;
    case 'paused':
      state.mode = state.prevMode;
      break;
    case 'levelclear':
      loadLevel(state.level + 1);
      state.mode = 'serve';
      flash(`LEVEL ${state.level + 1}`);
      break;
  }
}

function togglePause() {
  if (state.mode === 'playing' || state.mode === 'serve') {
    state.prevMode = state.mode;
    state.mode = 'paused';
  } else if (state.mode === 'paused') {
    state.mode = state.prevMode;
  }
}

function loseLife() {
  state.lives--;
  beep(180, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.05);
  if (state.lives <= 0) {
    state.mode = 'gameover';
    jingle([392, 330, 262, 196]);
  } else {
    resetBall();
    state.mode = 'serve';
    flash(state.lives === 1 ? 'LAST LIFE!' : `${state.lives} LIVES LEFT`);
  }
}

function levelCleared() {
  ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
  if (state.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
    state.mode = 'levelclear';
    jingle([523, 659, 784]);
  } else {
    state.mode = 'win';
    jingle([523, 659, 784, 1047, 1319]);
  }
}

// ---------- Physics ----------
function movePaddleTo(x) {
  paddle.x = clamp(x, 0, W - paddle.w);
}

function damageBrick(b) {
  b.hits--;
  if (b.hits > 0) {
    beep(220, 0.1, 'square', 0.05);
    return;
  }
  b.alive = false;
  state.score += b.type.points;
  beep(300 + b.type.points * 8, 0.08);
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const life = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    state.particles.push({
      x: b.x + Math.random() * b.w,
      y: b.y + Math.random() * b.h,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 260,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 260 - 60,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
      color: b.type.color,
      life,
      maxLife: life,
    });
  }
}

// Resolves at most one brick collision; returns true if a brick was hit.
function collideBricks() {
  for (const b of state.bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const cx = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
    const cy = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

    const overlapL = ball.x + BALL_R - b.x;
    const overlapR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - BALL_R);
    const overlapT = ball.y + BALL_R - b.y;
    const overlapB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - BALL_R);
    if (Math.min(overlapL, overlapR) < Math.min(overlapT, overlapB)) {
      if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    } else {
      if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    }
    damageBrick(b);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function stepBall(dt) {
  // Sub-step so the ball never moves more than half its radius at once (no tunneling).
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((state.speed * dt) / (BALL_R / 2)));
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * h;
    ball.y += ball.vy * h;

    if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) {
      ball.x = BALL_R;
      ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx);
      beep(330, 0.04);
    } else if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) {
      ball.x = W - BALL_R;
      ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx);
      beep(330, 0.04);
    }
    if (ball.y - BALL_R < HUD_H) {
      ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R;
      ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
      beep(330, 0.04);
    }

    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + BALL_R >= PADDLE_Y && ball.y - BALL_R <= PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H &&
        ball.x + BALL_R >= paddle.x && ball.x - BALL_R <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      // Bounce angle depends on where the ball hits the paddle.
      const hit = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2), -1, 1);
      const angle = hit * MAX_BOUNCE;
      state.speed = Math.min(state.speed * 1.02, LEVELS[state.level].ballSpeed * 1.4);
      ball.vx = state.speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -state.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R;
      beep(440, 0.06);
    }

    if (collideBricks() && state.bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) {
      levelCleared();
      return;
    }

    if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) {
      loseLife();
      return;
    }
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  if (state.mode === 'paused') return;

  state.flash.time = Math.max(0, state.flash.time - dt);
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    p.vy += 600 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
  }
  state.particles = state.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

  const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
  if (dir) movePaddleTo(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt);

  if (state.mode === 'serve') stickBall();
  else if (state.mode === 'playing') stepBall(dt);
}

// ---------- Rendering ----------
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#161c3a');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0a0d1c');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of state.bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const damaged = b.hits < b.type.hits;
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = damaged ? b.type.damaged : b.type.color;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 2);

    if (b.type.hits > 1) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40, 50, 70, 0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      roundRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2, 4);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (damaged) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(25, 30, 45, 0.85)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.45, b.y + b.h * 0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.38, b.y + b.h - 2);
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.45, b.y + b.h * 0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.68, b.y + b.h * 0.35);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, PADDLE_Y, 0, PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#b4c0ff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#5a67d8');
  roundRect(paddle.x, PADDLE_Y, paddle.w, PADDLE_H, 7);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBall() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = '#9ecbff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 1, W, 1);

  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = `600 20px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE  ${state.score}`, 20, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(`LEVEL  ${state.level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);

  const iconGap = 22, firstX = W - 28 - (START_LIVES - 1) * iconGap;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES', firstX - 16, HUD_H / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(firstX + i * iconGap, HUD_H / 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    if (i < state.lives) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5d73';
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  if (muted) {
    ctx.font = `13px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45)';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('SOUND OFF (M)', W - 12, H - 14);
  }
}

function blink(t) {
  return 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 5);
}

function drawOverlay(title, lines, prompt, t) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6, 9, 22, 0.78)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  let y = H / 2 - 30 - lines.length * 15;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = `800 54px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, y);

  y += 62;
  ctx.font = `19px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c9d3ff';
  for (const line of lines) {
    ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, y);
    y += 30;
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha = blink(t);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
  ctx.font = `700 22px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillText(prompt, W / 2, y + 22);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw(t) {
  drawBackground();
  drawBricks();
  drawParticles();
  drawPaddle();
  if (state.mode === 'serve' || state.mode === 'playing' || state.mode === 'paused') drawBall();
  drawHUD();

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  if ((state.mode === 'serve' || state.mode === 'playing') && state.flash.time > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, state.flash.time / 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = `800 36px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillText(state.flash.text, W / 2, 400);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  switch (state.mode) {
    case 'serve':
      ctx.globalAlpha = blink(t);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
      ctx.font = `600 18px ${FONT}`;
      ctx.fillText('Click or press SPACE to launch', W / 2, PADDLE_Y - 70);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    case 'title':
      drawOverlay('BRICK BREAKER', [
        'Mouse: move to steer the paddle, click to launch',
        'Keyboard: ← → or A / D to move, SPACE to launch',
        'P or Esc: pause     M: sound on / off',
        `Clear ${LEVELS.length} levels with ${START_LIVES} lives`,
      ], 'Click or press SPACE to start', t);
      break;
    case 'paused':
      drawOverlay('PAUSED', [], 'Click, SPACE or P to resume', t);
      break;
    case 'levelclear':
      drawOverlay(`LEVEL ${state.level + 1} CLEAR!`, [`Score: ${state.score}`],
        `Click or press SPACE for level ${state.level + 2}`, t);
      break;
    case 'gameover':
      drawOverlay('GAME OVER', [`Final score: ${state.score}`],
        'Click or press SPACE to play again', t);
      break;
    case 'win':
      drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', [`Final score: ${state.score}`, `Lives remaining: ${state.lives}`],
        'Click or press SPACE to play again', t);
      break;
  }

  const cursor = (state.mode === 'serve' || state.mode === 'playing') ? 'none' : 'default';
  if (canvas.style.cursor !== cursor) canvas.style.cursor = cursor;
}

// ---------- Input ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft':
    case 'KeyA':
      keys.left = true;
      break;
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'KeyD':
      keys.right = true;
      break;
    case 'Space':
    case 'Enter':
      if (!e.repeat) action();
      break;
    case 'KeyP':
    case 'Escape':
      if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
      break;
    case 'KeyM':
      if (!e.repeat) muted = !muted;
      break;
    default:
      return;
  }
  e.preventDefault();
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;
  if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = false;
});

function pointerToPaddle(e) {
  if (state.mode === 'paused') return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  movePaddleTo(x - paddle.w / 2);
}

window.addEventListener('pointermove', pointerToPaddle);
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  pointerToPaddle(e);
  action();
});

function autoPause() {
  keys.left = keys.right = false;
  if (state.mode === 'playing') togglePause();
}
window.addEventListener('blur', autoPause);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) autoPause(); });

// ---------- Main loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  const dt = clamp((now - last) / 1000, 0, 1 / 30);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw(now / 1000);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

    paddleWidth: 100,
    layout: [
      '....HH....',
      '...HaaH...',
      '..HabbaH..',
      '.HabccbaH.',
      'HabcddcbaH',
      '.HabccbaH.',
      '..HabbaH..',
      '...HaaH...',
      '....HH....',
    ],
  },
];

const COLS = 10, GAP = 6, SIDE = 30, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_TOP = HUD_H + 30;
const BRICK_W = (W - SIDE * 2 - GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
const PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 50, PADDLE_SPEED = 650;
const BALL_R = 8, MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3, START_LIVES = 3;

// ---------- State ----------
// mode: title | serve | playing | paused | levelclear | gameover | win
const state = {
  mode: 'title',
  prevMode: 'serve',
  score: 0,
  lives: START_LIVES,
  level: 0,
  speed: 0,
  bricks: [],
  particles: [],
  flash: { text: '', time: 0 },
};
const paddle = { x: 0, w: LEVELS[0].paddleWidth };
const ball = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 };
const keys = { left: false, right: false };

const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));

// ---------- Sound ----------
let audio = null, muted = false;

function ensureAudio() {
  try {
    if (!audio) {
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AC) audio = new AC();
    }
    if (audio && audio.state === 'suspended') audio.resume();
  } catch (e) { audio = null; }
}

function beep(freq, dur, type = 'square', vol = 0.05, delay = 0) {
  if (muted || !audio) return;
  const t0 = audio.currentTime + delay;
  const osc = audio.createOscillator();
  const gain = audio.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(audio.destination);
  osc.start(t0);
  osc.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
}

function jingle(notes) {
  notes.forEach((f, i) => beep(f, 0.18, 'triangle', 0.08, i * 0.12));
}

// ---------- Game flow ----------
function loadLevel(i) {
  const lvl = LEVELS[i];
  state.level = i;
  state.bricks = [];
  state.particles = [];
  lvl.layout.forEach((row, r) => {
    [...row].forEach((ch, c) => {
      const type = BRICK_TYPES[ch];
      if (!type) return;
      state.bricks.push({
        x: SIDE + c * (BRICK_W + GAP),
        y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + GAP),
        w: BRICK_W,
        h: BRICK_H,
        type,
        hits: type.hits,
        alive: true,
      });
    });
  });
  paddle.w = lvl.paddleWidth;
  paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
  resetBall();
}

function resetBall() {
  state.speed = LEVELS[state.level].ballSpeed;
  ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
  stickBall();
}

function stickBall() {
  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
  ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1;
}

function newGame() {
  state.score = 0;
  state.lives = START_LIVES;
  loadLevel(0);
  state.mode = 'serve';
  flash('LEVEL 1');
}

function launch() {
  const angle = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (Math.PI / 9); // up to ±20° from vertical
  ball.vx = state.speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.vy = -state.speed * Math.cos(angle);
  state.mode = 'playing';
  beep(520, 0.08);
}

function flash(text) {
  state.flash.text = text;
  state.flash.time = 1.6;
}

// Primary action: mouse click, Space or Enter.
function action() {
  ensureAudio();
  switch (state.mode) {
    case 'title':
    case 'gameover':
    case 'win':
      newGame();
      break;
    case 'serve':
      launch();
      break;
    case 'paused':
      state.mode = state.prevMode;
      break;
    case 'levelclear':
      loadLevel(state.level + 1);
      state.mode = 'serve';
      flash(`LEVEL ${state.level + 1}`);
      break;
  }
}

function togglePause() {
  if (state.mode === 'playing' || state.mode === 'serve') {
    state.prevMode = state.mode;
    state.mode = 'paused';
  } else if (state.mode === 'paused') {
    state.mode = state.prevMode;
  }
}

function loseLife() {
  state.lives--;
  beep(180, 0.4, 'sawtooth', 0.05);
  if (state.lives <= 0) {
    state.mode = 'gameover';
    jingle([392, 330, 262, 196]);
  } else {
    resetBall();
    state.mode = 'serve';
    flash(state.lives === 1 ? 'LAST LIFE!' : `${state.lives} LIVES LEFT`);
  }
}

function levelCleared() {
  ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
  if (state.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
    state.mode = 'levelclear';
    jingle([523, 659, 784]);
  } else {
    state.mode = 'win';
    jingle([523, 659, 784, 1047, 1319]);
  }
}

// ---------- Physics ----------
function movePaddleTo(x) {
  paddle.x = clamp(x, 0, W - paddle.w);
}

function damageBrick(b) {
  b.hits--;
  if (b.hits > 0) {
    beep(220, 0.1, 'square', 0.05);
    return;
  }
  b.alive = false;
  state.score += b.type.points;
  beep(300 + b.type.points * 8, 0.08);
  for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
    const life = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    state.particles.push({
      x: b.x + Math.random() * b.w,
      y: b.y + Math.random() * b.h,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 260,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 260 - 60,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
      color: b.type.color,
      life,
      maxLife: life,
    });
  }
}

// Resolves at most one brick collision; returns true if a brick was hit.
function collideBricks() {
  for (const b of state.bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const cx = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
    const cy = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > BALL_R * BALL_R) continue;

    const overlapL = ball.x + BALL_R - b.x;
    const overlapR = b.x + b.w - (ball.x - BALL_R);
    const overlapT = ball.y + BALL_R - b.y;
    const overlapB = b.y + b.h - (ball.y - BALL_R);
    if (Math.min(overlapL, overlapR) < Math.min(overlapT, overlapB)) {
      if (overlapL < overlapR) { ball.x -= overlapL; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else { ball.x += overlapR; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    } else {
      if (overlapT < overlapB) { ball.y -= overlapT; ball.vy = -Math.abs(ball.vy); }
      else { ball.y += overlapB; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }
    }
    damageBrick(b);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function stepBall(dt) {
  // Sub-step so the ball never moves more than half its radius at once (no tunneling).
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((state.speed * dt) / (BALL_R / 2)));
  const h = dt / steps;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    ball.x += ball.vx * h;
    ball.y += ball.vy * h;

    if (ball.x - BALL_R < 0) {
      ball.x = BALL_R;
      ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx);
      beep(330, 0.04);
    } else if (ball.x + BALL_R > W) {
      ball.x = W - BALL_R;
      ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx);
      beep(330, 0.04);
    }
    if (ball.y - BALL_R < HUD_H) {
      ball.y = HUD_H + BALL_R;
      ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy);
      beep(330, 0.04);
    }

    if (ball.vy > 0 &&
        ball.y + BALL_R >= PADDLE_Y && ball.y - BALL_R <= PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H &&
        ball.x + BALL_R >= paddle.x && ball.x - BALL_R <= paddle.x + paddle.w) {
      // Bounce angle depends on where the ball hits the paddle.
      const hit = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2), -1, 1);
      const angle = hit * MAX_BOUNCE;
      state.speed = Math.min(state.speed * 1.02, LEVELS[state.level].ballSpeed * 1.4);
      ball.vx = state.speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -state.speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = PADDLE_Y - BALL_R;
      beep(440, 0.06);
    }

    if (collideBricks() && state.bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) {
      levelCleared();
      return;
    }

    if (ball.y - BALL_R > H) {
      loseLife();
      return;
    }
  }
}

function update(dt) {
  if (state.mode === 'paused') return;

  state.flash.time = Math.max(0, state.flash.time - dt);
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    p.vy += 600 * dt;
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
  }
  state.particles = state.particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

  const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
  if (dir) movePaddleTo(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt);

  if (state.mode === 'serve') stickBall();
  else if (state.mode === 'playing') stepBall(dt);
}

// ---------- Rendering ----------
function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawBackground() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#161c3a');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#0a0d1c');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

function drawBricks() {
  for (const b of state.bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    const damaged = b.hits < b.type.hits;
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = damaged ? b.type.damaged : b.type.color;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 2);

    if (b.type.hits > 1) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40, 50, 70, 0.6)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      roundRect(b.x + 1, b.y + 1, b.w - 2, b.h - 2, 4);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (damaged) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(25, 30, 45, 0.85)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.3, b.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.45, b.y + b.h * 0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.38, b.y + b.h - 2);
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.45, b.y + b.h * 0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.68, b.y + b.h * 0.35);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
}

function drawParticles() {
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawPaddle() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, PADDLE_Y, 0, PADDLE_Y + PADDLE_H);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#b4c0ff');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#5a67d8');
  roundRect(paddle.x, PADDLE_Y, paddle.w, PADDLE_H, 7);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawBall() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = '#9ecbff';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, BALL_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 1, W, 1);

  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = `600 20px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText(`SCORE  ${state.score}`, 20, HUD_H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(`LEVEL  ${state.level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);

  const iconGap = 22, firstX = W - 28 - (START_LIVES - 1) * iconGap;
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('LIVES', firstX - 16, HUD_H / 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < START_LIVES; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(firstX + i * iconGap, HUD_H / 2, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    if (i < state.lives) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5d73';
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  if (muted) {
    ctx.font = `13px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45)';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText('SOUND OFF (M)', W - 12, H - 14);
  }
}

function blink(t) {
  return 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * 5);
}

function drawOverlay(title, lines, prompt, t) {
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6, 9, 22, 0.78)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  let y = H / 2 - 30 - lines.length * 15;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.font = `800 54px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, y);

  y += 62;
  ctx.font = `19px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#c9d3ff';
  for (const line of lines) {
    ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, y);
    y += 30;
  }

  ctx.globalAlpha = blink(t);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
  ctx.font = `700 22px ${FONT}`;
  ctx.fillText(prompt, W / 2, y + 22);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function draw(t) {
  drawBackground();
  drawBricks();
  drawParticles();
  drawPaddle();
  if (state.mode === 'serve' || state.mode === 'playing' || state.mode === 'paused') drawBall();
  drawHUD();

  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

  if ((state.mode === 'serve' || state.mode === 'playing') && state.flash.time > 0) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, state.flash.time / 0.5);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = `800 36px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillText(state.flash.text, W / 2, 400);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  switch (state.mode) {
    case 'serve':
      ctx.globalAlpha = blink(t);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
      ctx.font = `600 18px ${FONT}`;
      ctx.fillText('Click or press SPACE to launch', W / 2, PADDLE_Y - 70);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    case 'title':
      drawOverlay('BRICK BREAKER', [
        'Mouse: move to steer the paddle, click to launch',
        'Keyboard: ← → or A / D to move, SPACE to launch',
        'P or Esc: pause     M: sound on / off',
        `Clear ${LEVELS.length} levels with ${START_LIVES} lives`,
      ], 'Click or press SPACE to start', t);
      break;
    case 'paused':
      drawOverlay('PAUSED', [], 'Click, SPACE or P to resume', t);
      break;
    case 'levelclear':
      drawOverlay(`LEVEL ${state.level + 1} CLEAR!`, [`Score: ${state.score}`],
        `Click or press SPACE for level ${state.level + 2}`, t);
      break;
    case 'gameover':
      drawOverlay('GAME OVER', [`Final score: ${state.score}`],
        'Click or press SPACE to play again', t);
      break;
    case 'win':
      drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', [`Final score: ${state.score}`, `Lives remaining: ${state.lives}`],
        'Click or press SPACE to play again', t);
      break;
  }

  const cursor = (state.mode === 'serve' || state.mode === 'playing') ? 'none' : 'default';
  if (canvas.style.cursor !== cursor) canvas.style.cursor = cursor;
}

// ---------- Input ----------
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  switch (e.code) {
    case 'ArrowLeft':
    case 'KeyA':
      keys.left = true;
      break;
    case 'ArrowRight':
    case 'KeyD':
      keys.right = true;
      break;
    case 'Space':
    case 'Enter':
      if (!e.repeat) action();
      break;
    case 'KeyP':
    case 'Escape':
      if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
      break;
    case 'KeyM':
      if (!e.repeat) muted = !muted;
      break;
    default:
      return;
  }
  e.preventDefault();
});

window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') keys.left = false;
  if (e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') keys.right = false;
});

function pointerToPaddle(e) {
  if (state.mode === 'paused') return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  movePaddleTo(x - paddle.w / 2);
}

window.addEventListener('pointermove', pointerToPaddle);
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  pointerToPaddle(e);
  action();
});

function autoPause() {
  keys.left = keys.right = false;
  if (state.mode === 'playing') togglePause();
}
window.addEventListener('blur', autoPause);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) autoPause(); });

// ---------- Main loop ----------
let last = performance.now();
function frame(now) {
  const dt = clamp((now - last) / 1000, 0, 1 / 30);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  draw(now / 1000);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

loadLevel(0);
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

I wrote `index.html`, a single self-contained file with no dependencies. I haven't played it in a browser. I tried a quick automated syntax check, but it needed your permission, so I stopped there and read through the code instead.

**What's in it**
- **2 levels:**
  - **Level 1:** five rows of coloured bricks.
  - **Level 2:** a diamond of bricks, edged with steel bricks that take two hits. The ball is faster and the paddle is smaller.
- **Score:** shown in the top bar. Higher rows are worth more, and steel bricks are worth 100.
- **3 lives:** shown as dots in the top bar. Your score and remaining lives carry over into level 2. There are screens for clearing a level, game over and winning, and you can restart from the last two.

**Controls**
- **Mouse:** move to steer the paddle, click to launch the ball or start a game.
- **Keyboard:** ← → or A / D to move, Space or Enter to launch or start.
- **P or Esc** pauses, and **M** turns the sound effects on or off.

I added a few things you didn't ask for:
- The ball bounces off the paddle at an angle that depends on where it hits.
- The ball speeds up a little with each paddle hit.
- Broken bricks scatter particles.
- The game pauses itself when you switch away from the browser tab or window.

To play, open `index.html` in any modern browser.
